# Files

* [Include agent-facing text, never paraphrase it](auto-generated-pages.md) - Docs that show agent-facing text include the prompt files verbatim with literalinclude instead of paraphrasing them, so the docs cannot drift from what the agent actually reads.
* [README, docs landing page, agent overview](sync-overview-readme.md) - README and docs/index.md tell the same story and are updated together; the agent-facing overview.md is small, independent, and never a copy of either.
* [voice](voice.md) - Documentation voice — no first person ("I", "we"), use neutral or direct address
